name: vi-gross-receipts-tax
description: Work out and file the US Virgin Islands gross receipts tax for 2026. Covers the 5% tax on total business receipts with no deduction for costs, the two filing categories (monthly Form 720 V.I. above USD 225,000 a year, annual Form 720-B at USD 225,000 or less), the USD 9,000 monthly exemption applied month by month, exemption codes, up-front tax withheld by the VI Government, the 30-day deadlines (annual return due 30 January), zero returns, one consolidated return per sole proprietor, and the 5% a month (25% cap) penalty and 1% a month interest. Trigger on "USVI gross receipts tax", "Form 720 V.I.", "Form 720-B", "Virgin Islands GRT", "St. Thomas business tax", "BIR gross receipts". Not the British Virgin Islands.
